description: Erection of 3 storey 3-bedroom house incorporating a 4.8 m vehicle crossover and two parking spaces.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - No construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Fridays and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.
Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the house hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 8 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 9 - Before the development is commenced a scheme for protecting the proposed residential accommodation from excessive external noise shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and any works which form part of such a scheme shall be completed before any part of the development is first occupied or used.

Condition : 10 - The proposed three storey dwellinghouse, because of its position, design and appearance, would  complement the appearance of the locality and would comply with the Council's housing layout standards. It would not harm neighbours' living conditions. The development complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Backland Development/Infill Development).
